review.head: 6d4b80b91ce9da2406f3b8364c991fa91683870d
review.notes: Full review of a README-only revision (locators into seven books added, headings retitled, no statement changed). All 15 sampled targets recomputed numerically with an independent double-precision implementation; values agree with the README, including its corrections to DLMF 15.16.5 and 15.10.25. All 17 Whittaker-Watson locators read at the text (third edition) and the DLMF formulas of 15.4, 15.16, 15.2(i) read at the text; the locators into Andrews-Askey-Roy, Lebedev, Olver, Temme, Beals-Wong and Duverney (about 130) could not be read legally and are listed as not verifiable. Automatic checks all passed; dependency check 0 problems; Suggested.lean elaborates with 61 sorry warnings only. Small corrections: three renamed anchors linked by the open SpecialFunctionsHeun pull request with no mapping; three sentences of the description. Format note: Lean section comments keep the old layer titles.
